title: Staging over SFTP only: the rsync-and-rewrite playbook
lede: A working staging environment for legacy sites on bargain hosts that give you SFTP and nothing else. No shell, no git, no Docker. Just rsync, a search-replace, and a locked-down subdir.
hero_alt: Inked directory-tree blueprint, rsync run-sheet, manila SFTP tab, brass STAGING tag, red wax seal on .htaccess printout.
